title: Niven Ring: Concept Definition
description:
Niven Ring is a speculative habitat concept: imagined places for people to live beyond Earth. Signature concept-tech for study and imagination.

Niven rings are megastructures encircling stars at habitable distance with continent-scale living surface.

This database is the permanent archive for Niven Ring: its definition, three compounding model generations (Mark I, Mark II, Mark III - each better than the last), full specifications, runnable code demonstrations, applications, and safety framing. A ring around a star, a million Earths wide.

Speculative concept technology. Signature-generated for study, imagination, and design exploration. Not established real-world fact; not instructions for building weapons or hazardous devices. Nothing herein is medical, legal, or engineering advice.

title: Niven Ring: Principles and Idea Lineage
t: Niven Ring: Principles and Idea Lineage
description:
Principles of the Niven Ring. Habitat concepts trade capacity, self-sufficiency, comfort, and construction effort. Each generation houses more people more comfortably with less resupply.

The idea lineage: early speculation imagined the effect; bench prototypes proved the principle; refinement generations compounded performance; the mature form in this archive represents the best understood version of the concept.

How to read this database: start with the concept definition (ladder 1), study each Mark generation in order (ladder 2-3), run the code demonstrations, then review applications and safety.

title: Niven Ring: Development Roadmap
description:
Niven Ring - development roadmap (concept plan).

Phase 1 (Mark I): prove the principle with instrumented prototypes and publish everything. Phase 2 (Mark II): refine to practical reliability with independent safety review. Phase 3 (Mark III): mature to routine operation with full lifecycle support.

Each phase gates on the previous: no phase begins until the prior phase meets its safety and performance criteria in open review.
